after.asserts: Partition the coordinates into consecutive blocks of lengths $L_j=2^{2^j}$ for $j\ge1$. In odd-numbered blocks set $X_i=0$ deterministically; in even-numbered blocks let the $X_i$ be fair independent bits. Independence gives the block law $p_{0:N-1}(x_0^{N-1})=\prod_{i=0}^{N-1}p_i(x_i)$. Expanding its finite entropy sum over positive-probability words and using $\log_2\prod_i p_i(x_i)=\sum_i\log_2p_i(x_i)$ yields $$H(X_0^{N-1})=\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}H(X_i),$$ since each other coordinate probability sums to one. Thus the entropy contribution is zero on odd blocks and one bit per coordinate on even blocks.
